record.title: ArchitectUI
record.description: Bootstrap 5 admin dashboard with 26 pages: dashboard widgets, UI elements, components, forms, tables, Chart.js charts and a calendar.

record.author: DashboardPack

pages.title: Analytics Dashboard - This is an example dashboard created using build-in elements and components.
ChartJS - Huge selection of charts created with the React ChartJS Plugin
Accordions - Accordions represent collapsable component with extended functionality.
Calendar - Calendars are used in a lot of apps. We thought to include one for React.
Carousels & Slideshows - Create easy and beautiful slideshows with these React components.
Maps - Implement in your applications Google or vector maps.
Modals - Wide selection of modal dialogs styles and animations available.
Notifications - Notifications represent one of the best ways to give feedback for various users actions.
Pagination - Basic and dynamic pagination for use in your next awesome application.
Progress Bar - You can use the progress bars on their own or in combination with other widgets.
Scrollable Elements - Add scrolling areas to any elements with custom scrollbars or default browser ones.
Tabs - Tabs are used to split content between multiple sections. Wide variety available.
Tooltips & Popovers - These React components are used to add interaction or extra information for your app's conten
Dashboard Boxes - Highly configurable boxes best used for showing numbers in an user friendly way.
Badges & Labels - Badges and labels are used to offer extra small pieces of info for your content.
Standard Buttons - Wide selection of buttons that feature different styles for backgrounds, borders and hover options!
Cards - Wide selection of cards with multiple styles, borders, actions and hover effects.
Dropdowns - Multiple styles, actions and effects are available for the Archited Framework dropdown buttons.
Icons - Wide icons selection including from flag icons to FontAwesome and other icons libraries.
List Groups - These can be used with other components and elements to create stunning and unique new elements for your U
Navigation Menus - Navigation menus are one of the basic building blocks for any web or mobile app.
Utilities - These are helpers that speed up the dev time for various components and effects.
Form Controls - Wide selection of forms controls, using the Bootstrap 5 code base, but built with React.
Form Layouts - Build whatever layout you need with our Architect framework.
Form Validation - Inline validation is very easy to implement using the Architect Framework.
Regular Tables - Tables are the backbone of almost all web applications.
